statement: Ukrainian authorities report at least one civilian killed by a Russian missile or drone strike in Kyiv city or Kyiv oblast between 2026-08-11 and 2026-09-10.
resolution: Kyiv city or oblast military administration reports a civilian killed in a strike dated between 2026-08-11 and 2026-09-10, carried by two of Reuters, AP, AFP, BBC.
failure_condition: No civilian death from a Russian strike occurs in Kyiv city or Kyiv oblast within the stated window.

statement: A continuing appropriations act extending US federal funding past 2026-09-30 is enacted into law between 2026-08-09 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: Congress.gov shows a continuing appropriations measure with status Became Public Law, enactment date between 2026-08-09 and 2026-09-30, funding agencies beyond 2026-09-30.
failure_condition: No such measure carries Became Public Law status with an enactment date inside the window.

statement: At least one commercial vessel is struck by missile, drone, mine, or explosive boat in the Strait of Hormuz, Persian Gulf, or Gulf of Oman between 2026-08-11 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: UKMTO publishes an incident advisory placing a struck commercial vessel in that area between 2026-08-11 and 2026-09-30, and Reuters or AP reports the strike.
failure_condition: No commercial vessel is struck in the named waters during the window.

statement: GDACS issues a Red alert for a tropical cyclone in the Northwest Pacific basin with an event date between 2026-08-11 and 2026-10-15.
resolution: The GDACS event record lists a Northwest Pacific tropical cyclone at alert level Red with an event date between 2026-08-11 and 2026-10-15.
failure_condition: No Northwest Pacific tropical cyclone reaches GDACS Red alert level inside the window.

statement: CISA adds a Metabase vulnerability to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a date-added value between 2026-08-09 and 2026-10-15.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog JSON contains an entry naming Metabase in vendorProject or product with dateAdded between 2026-08-09 and 2026-10-15.
failure_condition: The KEV catalog holds no Metabase entry with a dateAdded value inside the window.

statement: CISA adds at least 25 distinct CVE records to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with date-added values between 2026-08-10 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: Count of distinct cveID entries in the CISA KEV catalog with dateAdded between 2026-08-10 and 2026-09-30 inclusive is 25 or greater.

statement: The BLS Employment Situation released 2026-09-04 shows total nonfarm payroll employment change for August 2026 below zero.
resolution: Seasonally adjusted total nonfarm payroll change for August 2026, as first published by BLS on 2026-09-04, is a negative number.
failure_condition: The first-published August 2026 nonfarm payroll change is zero or positive.

statement: Iran publicly announces an agreed arrangement permitting international commercial transit of the Strait of Hormuz between 2026-08-11 and 2026-10-15.
resolution: The Iranian foreign ministry, IRGC, or presidency announces a Hormuz transit or reopening arrangement dated in the window, reported by two of Reuters, AP, AFP, Al Jazeera.
failure_condition: No Iranian state announcement of a Hormuz transit arrangement occurs inside the window.

statement: The FOMC lowers the federal funds target range at its 2026-09-15 to 2026-09-16 meeting.
resolution: The FOMC statement issued 2026-09-16 sets a target range whose upper limit is below the FRED DFEDTARU value in effect on 2026-09-14.
failure_condition: The upper limit of the target range on 2026-09-17 equals or exceeds the level in effect on 2026-09-14.

statement: ICE Brent front-month crude futures settle at or above 95.00 US dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-08-10 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: ICE published settlement for the front-month Brent contract is 95.00 or higher on at least one session between 2026-08-10 and 2026-09-30.
failure_condition: Every front-month Brent settlement in that range is below 95.00.
